headline: Indian markets trade cautiously around 22,700 while Adani Ports rises post Q2 results

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Heavyweight stocks like Infosys and Reliance dropped 3% each, putting pressure on benchmark indices.
BSE Sensex ended lower by over 350 points with Nifty closing below the key 22,700 level.
Elevated crude oil prices and European gas price spikes added to global economic concerns.
Investors evaluated outcomes from the US Fed FOMC meeting and foreign investor capital flows.
whatHappening: Adani Ports shares jumped 3% after Q2 results as Jefferies and Nomura raised target prices.
Largecaps held up relative strength even as the broader market faced sliding pressure.
Antala Industries SME IPO opened for subscription today.
Potential discussions around LTCG tax cuts are seen as key to reviving FII inflows into Indian equities.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices faced downward pressure as Sensex dropped over 350 points and Nifty slipped below 22,700, led by losses in Reliance and Infosys.
In contrast, Adani Ports gained 3% post Q2 earnings boosted by target price upgrades from major brokerages.
Investors remain focused on global central bank cues, energy prices, and largecap resilience amid broader market volatility.
